title: Computational investigation of FDA approved drugs as selective PARP-1 inhibitors by targeting BRCT domain for cancer therapy.
authors: Kumar, Chandan; Lakshmi, P T V; Arunachalam, Annamalai
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过计算筛选FDA药物靶向PARP-1的BRCT结构域，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase-1 is a promising target for the treatment of cancer due to its involvement in base excision repair pathways for repairing DNA single-strand breaks. However, available PARP-1 inhibitors target a highly conserved PARPs catalytic domain, which causes toxicity due to the off-target activity. Therefore, the present study was hypothesized to identify selective inhibitors by targeting specific protein-protein interacting (PPI) PARP-1 BRCT domain. Moreover, PPI hotspot residues (Gly399, Lys400, Leu401, Lys441 & Lys442) and a druggable pocket was detected to screen small molecule inhibitors. Hence, two FDA approved drug molecules (levoleucovorin and balsalazide) were recognized to fit in the druggable pocket. Since they are already under investigation for anti-cancer activity, thus could be further explored in PARP-1 sensitive cancer cells to expand their selectivity and develop as effective anti-cancer agents. Besides, the study also provides detailed structural insight of PARP-1 and XRCC1 complex through their BRCT domains.
abstract_zh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶-1因其参与碱基切除修复途径以修复DNA单链断裂，成为癌症治疗的一个有前景的靶点。然而，现有的PARP-1抑制剂靶向高度保守的PARPs催化域，这因脱靶活性而导致毒性。因此，本研究假设通过靶向特定的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）PARP-1 BRCT域来识别选择性抑制剂。此外，检测到PPI热点残基（Gly399、Lys400、Leu401、Lys441和Lys442）及一个可成药口袋，以筛选小分子抑制剂。因此，识别出两种FDA批准的药物分子（左亚叶酸和巴柳氮）能够适配该可成药口袋。由于它们已在抗癌活性研究中，因此可进一步在PARP-1敏感癌细胞中探索，以扩大其选择性并开发为有效的抗癌药物。此外，该研究还通过其BRCT域提供了PARP-1和XRCC1复合物的详细结构见解。
